To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

IP3 is a Ca2+-mobilizing messenger in the insulin-secreting cell, and that its action is not limited to the release of Ca2+ from the endoplasmatic reticulum, since it can also release Ca2+ from mitochondria.

IP3 mobilizes Ca2+ from the endoplasmical reticulum of permeabilized insulin secreting cells, and that the IP3-induced Ca(2+) mobilization is rapid, reversible and is not inhibited by the respiratory inhibitor antimycin.
IP3 mobilizes intracellular calcium stores from permeabilized cells and that the kinetics and extent of the response is compatible with the known metabolism of IP3.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the role of inositol 3,4,5 trisphosphate (IP3) in the regulation of insulin release in pancreatic islets.
the role of Ca2+ in the release of insulin.
elucidating the mechanisms by which insulin secretion is controlled.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IP3 is a second messenger in the regulation of Ca2+ release from endoplasmic and sarcoplasmic reticular stores.
IP3 is a mediator of Ca2+ mobilization in the beta-cell and that it can act as a signal in the control of insulin release.
inositol 3,4,5 triphosphate is a second messenger for the stimulation of insulin secretion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IP3 mobilized intracellular Ca2+, which could be released by the endoplamic reticulum and mitochondria.
the Ca2+ mobilizing agent IP3 is a likely candidate as a second messenger for insulin secretion.
the Ca2+ signal generated in the beta-cell is amplified by the IP3/Ca2+ release mechanism.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IP3 is a very potent regulator of cytosolic free calcium.
IP3 is a key player in Ca(2+) homeostasis in the pancreatic beta cell, and that it can mobilize Ca(2+) from the endoplasmatic reticulum.
inositol 3,4,5 trisphosphate is a second messenger that is released by the hormone insulin and that it can mobilize intracellular calcium in the pancreatic islet cell.
